name: zreader_free_node_recursive
description: zReader::FreeNodeRecursive releases string node payloads and recursively releases array node payloads before clearing the node value.
known_limits: VC5SP3 /O2 /Ob1 /MD /GX /Zp4 COFF byte comparison for @zReader_FreeNodeRecursive@4 at 0x48ce60 passes with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking relocation bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x48ce60 has no current warnings and validates the fastcall node argument, string node type 3 freeing node->value.str and clearing the value, array node type 4 iterating node->value.nodes[0].value.i32 entries from index 0, recursively freeing each child node, freeing the array allocation, and clearing node->value.nodes.
The dependency frontier for 0x48ce60 reports no source blockers; its only indirect dependency is the CRT free provider boundary.

Native smoke zreader_free_loaded_tree_smoke directly verifies string payload cleanup leaves the node value null, directly verifies recursive array cleanup leaves the array node value null, and later reaches the helper through zReader::FreeLoadedTree on a heap root.
